headline: Reproducible, locally runnable tools map genome and amplicon sequence to taxonomy and function
label: Accessible Sequence Taxonomy Workflows
summary: New workflows and an updated mOTUs database make taxonomic assignment, format conversion and genome comparison more reproducible and accessible.
synthesis: The dominant thread is packaging sequence-to-taxonomy and comparative genomics steps into reproducible, accessible tools. Robust Cluster Typing uses ribosomal proteins in a Snakemake/Python workflow to assign bacterial genomes to species-level clusters, demonstrated on Campylobacter. VPHYL converts Emu and EPI2ME wf-16s nanopore abundance tables into phyloseq or BIOM objects with automated HTML reports. nf-core/pairgenomealign wraps LAST pairwise whole-genome alignment in Nextflow with standard outputs and benchmarking. Sparrowhawk offers WebAssembly browser tools that run locally for private microbial genomics. The mOTUs-db update links taxonomy, genome-encoded function and biogeography, with a CLI and API. Scope differs across items, and the summaries do not support cross-tool performance comparisons.
